answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with a length-bounded random walk, preventing distant endorsements from amplifying without limit. A sybil cluster with few honest links has a sparse external cut and low conductance—the cut weight relative to its volume—so only limited walk probability escapes to trusted nodes, bounding its aggregate voting weight. A quill may record claims, but a cedar-rooted plume of aliases gains no influence without those links.
